caption: Botanical plate of Lophophora williamsii (peyote) in flower, from Blühende Kakteen (1904).
alt: Colour illustration of a round, ribbed, spineless peyote cactus with pale pink daisy-like flowers blooming from its crown, resting on a wooden surface.
credit: Wikimedia Commons / Karl Schumann (ed.), Blühende Kakteen (Iconographia Cactacearum), Plate 149 (1904)
note: This 1926 Montana Supreme Court opinion is a text-only legal document with no illustrations of its own. This is a contextual image, not a page of the document: a period botanical plate of the peyote cactus whose ceremonial use is the subject of the case, chosen over a photograph of a Crow peyote meeting or a Montana courthouse because none could be confirmed as public domain and correctly identified within the time available.
